ios.desc:
Turn your Strava, Apple Health, or Garmin workouts into widgets you can read at a glance. Track running, cycling, swimming, skiing, multi-sport, and steps right from your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

- Pick your data source
Connect Strava, Apple Health, or Garmin and switch whenever you want.

- See your progress instantly
Choose small, medium, and large widgets with weekly, monthly, and yearly stats and metric trends.

- Track the metrics that matter
Follow mileage, pace, elevation, heart rate zones, goals, heatmaps across time periods, Training Load (TRIMP), Metric Trends, Cycling Power and Achievements.

- Great for Apple Health too
Use Steps Mode, goal widgets, and trend views even without Strava.

- Privacy-first
Your workout data stays on your device. We do not track users.

Whether you're training for a race or just want a better workout dashboard, Dash keeps your progress visible all day.

More widgets and metrics are coming soon.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dashworkouts.app/privacy/

quotes.text: In my spare time I created Dash. An app used to track metrics from Strava in the form of iOS widgets. Officially Strava hasn't done much on this front, so I took the matter into my own hands. After two years, I still use Dash every day. https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/dash-widgets-for-strava/id1556281712
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What apps have you created for your own use?
